items.titleZh: 美国亿万富翁罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊收购阿斯顿·马丁F1少数股权
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁已将其F1车队的少数股权出售给美国亿万富翁罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊，后者将加入董事会担任副主席。约翰逊是强生制药帝国的继承人，也是NFL球队纽约喷气机队的老板，去年还收购了英超球队水晶宫的主要股份。
items.originalTitle: 美国亿万富翁罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊收购阿斯顿·马丁F1少数股权
items.summaryEn: Aston Martin has sold a minority stake in its Formula 1 team to US billionaire Robert Wood Johnson, who joins the board of directors as vice chairman. Johnson, an heir of the Johnson & Johnson pharmaceutical empire, also owns the New York Jets NFL team and acquired a major stake in Premier League football team Crystal Palace last year.
detailZh: 美国亿万富翁罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊收购阿斯顿·马丁F1少数股权
纽约喷气机队老板、唐纳德·特朗普的捐助者、前美国驻英国大使罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊已收购阿斯顿·马丁一级方程式车队的少数股权
伍迪·约翰逊已收购这支英国车队的少数股权
阿斯顿·马丁已将其一级方程式车队的少数股权出售给美国亿万富翁罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊，后者将加入董事会担任副主席。
约翰逊是强生制药帝国的继承人，还拥有NFL球队纽约喷气机队，并于去年收购了英超足球俱乐部水晶宫的主要股份。
这位79岁的老人是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的长期捐助者，并在特朗普当选后于2017年至2021年期间担任美国驻英国大使。
约翰逊现已被阿斯顿·马丁老板劳伦斯·斯特罗尔引入，以推动这支银石车队在美国的商业增长，美国对这项系列赛来说是一个重要市场。车队强调约翰逊不会参与车队的日常管理。
约翰逊表示：“在我担任美国驻英国大使期间，我对阿斯顿·马丁的悠久历史以及劳伦斯·斯特罗尔的战略眼光和企业家精神深表赞赏。”
“我很高兴能与他合作，为车队的持续发展做出贡献，并立志打造一个能够在赛车运动最高水平上竞争的组织。
“我们还共同致力于在美国扩大粉丝基础，让更多粉丝领略一级方程式的激情。”
斯特罗尔补充道：“我非常高兴欢迎伍迪加入阿斯顿·马丁大家庭。他的经验、热情和投资进一步巩固了我们的地位，帮助我们迈入竞争旅程的下一阶段。
“他对我们品牌的深刻理解，加上他对创新和商业机会的承诺，使他成为我们展望未来时的理想合作伙伴。”
detailEn: US billionaire Robert Wood Johnson acquires minor Aston Martin F1 stake
New York Jets owner, Donald Trump donor and former US ambassador to the UK Robert Wood Johnson has acquired a minority stake in the Aston Martin Formula 1 team
Woody Johnson has acquired a minority stake in the British team
Aston Martin has sold a minority stake in its Formula 1 team to US billionaire Robert Wood Johnson, who joins the board of directors as vice chairman.
Johnson, an heir of the Johnson & Johnson pharmaceutical empire, also owns the New York Jets NFL team and acquired a major stake in Premier League football team Crystal Palace last year.
The 79-year-old is a long-time donor of US president Donald Trump, and served as US ambassador to the UK between 2017 and 2021 following Trump's election.

Johnson has now been brought in by Aston owner Lawrence Stroll to advance the Silverstone team's commercial growth in the US, which is an important market for the series. The team stressed Johnson would not be involved in the team's daily management.

"During my time as US Ambassador to the United Kingdom, I have developed a deep appreciation for Aston Martin's rich history, as well as Lawrence Stroll’s strategic vision and entrepreneurial spirit," Johnson said.
"I am excited to partner with him and contribute to the continued development of the team, with the ambition of building an organisation capable of competing at the very highest level of the sport.
"We also share a commitment to growing the fanbase in the United States and introducing even more fans to the excitement of Formula 1."

Stroll added: "I am extremely happy to welcome Woody to the Aston Martin family. His experience, passion and investment further strengthen our position as we enter the next phase of our competitive journey.
"His deep appreciation for our brand, combined with his commitment to innovation and commercial opportunity, makes him an ideal partner as we look to the future.”
keyPointsZh: 约翰逊曾于2017年至2021年担任美国驻英国大使，并且是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的长期捐助者。
阿斯顿·马丁老板劳伦斯·斯特罗尔引入约翰逊，旨在推动车队在美国这一重要市场的商业增长，但车队强调约翰逊不会参与日常管理。
约翰逊表示，他在担任美国驻英国大使期间对阿斯顿·马丁的悠久历史以及劳伦斯·斯特罗尔的战略眼光和企业家精神深表赞赏。
keyPointsEn: Johnson served as US ambassador to the UK between 2017 and 2021 and is a long-time donor of US president Donald Trump.
Aston owner Lawrence Stroll brought in Johnson to advance the team's commercial growth in the US, an important market, but the team stressed Johnson would not be involved in daily management.

Johnson said that during his time as US Ambassador to the UK, he developed a deep appreciation for Aston Martin's rich history, as well as Lawrence Stroll's strategic vision and entrepreneurial spirit.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘曾考虑离开F1，最终决定与红牛续约
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘表示，在考虑是否继续留在F1后，他决定与红牛续约，并将“接受”F1中不受欢迎的动力单元规则。

media.altZh: 维斯塔潘曾考虑离开F1，最终决定与红牛续约

items.originalTitle: 维斯塔潘曾考虑离开F1，最终决定与红牛续约
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen says he considered whether he wanted to keep racing in Formula 1 before deciding to sign a new deal to drive for Red Bull. He will remain at Red Bull until at least 2030 and is prepared to tolerate the power unit regulations until then.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘表示，在决定签署一份为红牛驾驶的新合同之前，他曾考虑过自己是否还想继续参加F1比赛。
车队今天宣布将他的原有合同延长，该合同原本到2028年。维斯塔潘将至少留在红牛至2030年。
维斯塔潘一直直言不讳地批评F1的动力单元规则。这项运动将在未来几个赛季对其引入修订，但在2030年之前无法做出重大改变。然而维斯塔潘表示，他准备在此之前容忍这种情况。
他说，他年初的不确定“主要是关于是否真的继续参加F1”。
“但规则正在慢慢变得好一些，可以说，我愿意接受它。希望到2030年能打开另一个机会，可能是V8引擎的到来，让我重新考虑。”
维斯塔潘在履行F1承诺的同时，已开始参加其他系列赛，包括今年的纽博格林24小时。他表示打算继续参加其他锦标赛。
“对我来说，这绝对是我想要继续做的事情，”他说。“但当然，这有点取决于F1赛历，明年什么会是可能的。”
他最感兴趣的是参加“所有大型耐力赛——一般来说就是24小时比赛，驾驶它们会很酷。”
随着红牛近几个赛季状态下滑，维斯塔潘一直被传为梅赛德斯和迈凯伦等对手车队的目标。当被问及时，维斯塔潘没有否认他的管理团队曾与对手车队交谈，他回答说：“无所谓。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen says he considered whether he wanted to keep racing in Formula 1 before deciding to sign a new deal to drive for Red Bull.
The team today announced an extension to his previous deal which ran to 2028. Verstappen will remain at Red Bull until at least 2030.

Verstappen has been an outspoken critic of F1’s power unit regulations. The sport will introduce revisions to them over the coming seasons but significant change is not possible before 2030. However Verstappen said he is prepared to tolerate the situation until then.
He said his uncertainty early in the year was “mainly about actually continuing in Formula 1.”

“But the rules are slowly getting a bit better and, let’s say, I’m willing to live with it. And hopefully by 2030 it opens up another opportunity, potentially with V8 engines coming in, to look again.”
Verstappen has begun competing in other series alongside his F1 commitments, including the Nurburgring 24 Hours earlier this year. He said he intends to continue racing in other championships.
“For me that was definitely something that I want to keep doing,” he said. “But, of course, it depends a bit on the F1 calendar, what will be possible also next year.”
He is most interested in entering “all the big endurance ones – 24-hour races in general, they would be cool to drive in.”

As Red Bull’s form has dipped in recent seasons, Verstappen has been tipped as a target for rival teams such as Mercedes and McLaren. When asked, Verstappen did not deny his management had spoken with rival teams, replying: “it doesn’t matter”.
keyPointsZh: 红牛宣布将维斯塔潘原有至2028年的合同延长，他至少留队至2030年。
维斯塔潘一直公开批评F1动力单元规则，但表示愿意接受现状，并希望2030年V8引擎带来新机会。
维斯塔潘已开始参加其他赛事，包括今年的纽博格林24小时，并打算继续参加其他锦标赛，尤其对24小时耐力赛感兴趣。
keyPointsEn: Red Bull announced an extension to Verstappen's previous deal which ran to 2028; he will remain at Red Bull until at least 2030.
Verstappen has been an outspoken critic of F1's power unit regulations but said he is willing to live with them, hoping V8 engines by 2030 open another opportunity.
Verstappen has begun competing in other series, including the Nurburgring 24 Hours earlier this year, and intends to continue racing in other championships, especially 24-hour endurance races.

items.titleZh: TWG否认出售凯迪拉克F1车队
items.summaryZh: TWG否认凯迪拉克F1车队将被出售。此前其CEO马克·沃尔特因涉嫌欺诈和掩盖行为正接受美国司法部和证券交易委员会调查，并已出售其在洛杉矶湖人队的股份。

media.altZh: TWG否认出售凯迪拉克F1车队

items.originalTitle: TWG否认出售凯迪拉克F1车队
items.summaryEn: TWG has denied that the Cadillac F1 team is up for sale. This follows an investigation into CEO Mark Walter by US authorities over alleged fraud and a cover-up scheme, and his recent sale of his stake in the Los Angeles Lakers.
detailZh: TWG否认凯迪拉克F1车队将被出售，此前其CEO马克·沃尔特在美国接受调查。
马克·沃尔特在F1中可能并不为人熟知，但对凯迪拉克车队而言，他具有根本性的重要性。这位亿万富翁是TWG公司的首席执行官，该公司负责运营通用汽车在F1的参赛项目。目前，他正受到美国当局的审查，这引发了关于车队可能出售的传闻。
近期，沃尔特出售了他在NBA洛杉矶湖人队的股份——仅在他收购一年之后——而美国有报道称，他正在考虑出售他在其他体育项目中的股份，包括英超俱乐部切尔西、美国职棒大联盟的洛杉矶道奇，甚至凯迪拉克F1和Andretti Global。
据报道，这些举措旨在筹集流动性，以应对针对他正在进行的调查。
然而，周四在荷兰大奖赛上，凯迪拉克试图平息猜测，表示车队不会出售。
凯迪拉克F1车队CEO丹·托里斯本周末未出席赞德沃特——这是新领队马尔钦·布德科夫斯基上任后的第一站——因为他正在华盛顿特区与Andretti Autosport一起参加IndyCar赛事，该赛事有美国总统唐纳德·特朗普出席。
马尔钦·布德科夫斯基，凯迪拉克F1车队领队
TWG于2024年从迈克尔·安德雷蒂手中收购了Andretti的股份，这一关键举措使国际汽联、F1和竞争对手车队批准凯迪拉克作为第11支车队参加2026年的比赛。
目前，美国司法部和证券交易委员会正在调查马克·沃尔特，指控其涉嫌欺诈和掩盖行为，涉及他旗下保险公司Delaware Life、Clear Spring和EquiTrust的资金管理。
调查正在审查一个未披露的“自贷”网络的合法性——估计在160至200亿美元之间——这些资金从他的保险公司流向与这位亿万富翁本人有关的企业。
据报道，这些资金通过中介公司和不透明的有限责任公司结构进行流转，以逃避该行业的监管控制和法律限制。
在美国，同一人拥有的公司之间可以合法借贷，前提是交易向监管机构申报，以避免损害对客户的偿付能力。
detailEn: TWG has denied the Cadillac F1 team is up for sale following an investigation into CEO Mark Walter in the US

Mark Walter might be unfamiliar in Formula 1, but for the Cadillac team, he holds fundamental relevance. The billionaire is the CEO of TWG, the company responsible for operating General Motors' Formula 1 entry, and currently he is under scrutiny by authorities in the United States which has sparked rumours regarding a potential sale of the team.

Recently, Walter sold his stake in the NBA's Los Angeles Lakers – just one year after acquiring it – while reports in the US have emerged that he is considering selling his shares in other sports ventures; including Premier League club Chelsea, MLB's Los Angeles Dodgers, and even Cadillac F1 and Andretti Global.
These moves are reportedly aimed at raising liquidity to deal with the ongoing investigation against him.
However, on Thursday at the Dutch Grand Prix, Cadillac sought to quell the speculation by stating the team was not up for sale.

Dan Towriss, Cadillac F1 team CEO, is not in attendance at Zandvoort this weekend – the first round with new team principal Marcin Budkowski at the helm - because he is with Andretti Autosport at the IndyCar race in Washington D.C., an event featuring the presence of U.S. President Donald Trump.
Marcin Budkowski, Team Principal of Cadillac F1 Team
TWG acquired Andretti in 2024 after purchasing the stake from Michael Andretti, a key move that allowed the FIA, F1, and rival teams to approve Cadillac’s entry as the 11th team on the grid for 2026.

Currently, the U.S. Department of Justice and the Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating Mark Walter for an alleged fraud and cover-up scheme involving the management of funds at his insurance companies Delaware Life, Clear Spring, and EquiTrust.

The investigation is examining the legality of a network of undisclosed "self-loans" – estimated between $16-20billion – channelled from his insurance companies to businesses linked to the billionaire himself.
The money reportedly circulated through intermediary firms and an opaque structure of limited liability companies to evade regulatory controls and legal limits in the sector.

In the United States, companies owned by the same individual can legally lend money to one another, provided the transactions are declared to regulators to avoid compromising solvency toward customers.
keyPointsZh: 沃尔特出售湖人股份及可能出售切尔西、洛杉矶道奇、凯迪拉克F1和Andretti Global股份，据称是为应对调查筹集流动性。
凯迪拉克F1车队CEO丹·托里斯未出席赞德沃特荷兰大奖赛，他正在华盛顿特区参加IndyCar赛事，该赛事有美国总统特朗普出席。
美国司法部和证券交易委员会正在调查沃尔特旗下保险公司Delaware Life、Clear Spring和EquiTrust之间约160至200亿美元未披露“自贷”的合法性。
keyPointsEn: Walter's sale of his Lakers stake and possible sales of shares in Chelsea, the Los Angeles Dodgers, Cadillac F1 and Andretti Global are reportedly aimed at raising liquidity to deal with the investigation.
Cadillac F1 team CEO Dan Towriss is not attending the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort as he is at the IndyCar race in Washington D.C., an event attended by U.S. President Donald Trump.

The U.S. Department of Justice and the Securities and Exchange Commission are investigating the legality of undisclosed "self-loans" estimated between $16-20 billion among Walter's insurance companies Delaware Life, Clear Spring and EquiTrust.

items.originalTitle: TWG否认出售凯迪拉克F1车队，此前马克·沃尔特遭调查
items.summaryEn: TWG has denied rumours that the Cadillac F1 team is for sale after CEO Mark Walter came under investigation by US authorities. The billionaire recently sold his stake in the Los Angeles Lakers and is reportedly considering selling shares in other sports ventures.
detailZh: TWG否认凯迪拉克F1车队将被出售，此前美国方面对马克·沃尔特展开了调查
在美国对首席执行官马克·沃尔特进行调查后，TWG否认凯迪拉克F1车队正在挂牌出售
马克·沃尔特在F1世界里可能并不出名，但对凯迪拉克车队来说，他至关重要。这位亿万富翁是TWG的首席执行官，而TWG正是负责运营通用汽车F1参赛项目的公司。目前他正受到美国当局的审查，这也引发了关于车队可能被出售的传闻。
最近，沃尔特出售了他在NBA洛杉矶湖人队的股份——距离他买入仅过去一年——同时美国媒体报道称，他正在考虑出售自己在其他体育项目中的股份，包括英超俱乐部切尔西、MLB的洛杉矶道奇队，甚至包括凯迪拉克F1车队和安德雷蒂全球。
据报道，这些举措旨在筹集流动资金，以应对针对他正在进行的一项调查。
不过，在周四的荷兰大奖赛上，凯迪拉克试图平息种种猜测，声明车队并不出售。
凯迪拉克F1车队首席执行官丹·托里斯本周末未出现在赞德沃特——这是新车队负责人马尔钦·布德科夫斯基执掌后的第一站比赛——因为他正在华盛顿特区陪同安德雷蒂车队参加印地赛车比赛，该赛事现场有美国总统唐纳德·特朗普出席。
TWG于2024年从迈克尔·安德雷蒂手中购得股份后收购了安德雷蒂车队，这一关键举措使得国际汽联、F1以及各竞争对手车队得以批准凯迪拉克作为第11支车队参加2026年的比赛。
目前，美国司法部和美国证券交易委员会正在调查马克·沃尔特，指控其涉嫌一项涉及旗下保险公司——特拉华人寿（Delaware Life）、清水泉（Clear Spring）和EquiTrust——资金管理的欺诈及掩盖计划。
这项调查正在审查一个未公开的“自我贷款”网络的合法性——据估计金额在160亿至200亿美元之间——这些资金从他旗下的保险公司输送至与这位亿万富翁本人有关联的企业。
据报道，这些资金通过中间公司以及一个由有限责任公司组成的不透明结构流转，以规避该行业的监管控制和法律限制。
在美国，同一人拥有的公司之间合法地互相放贷是允许的，前提是相关交易必须向监管机构申报，以避免损害对客户的偿付能力。
detailEn: TWG denies sale of Cadillac F1 team following investigation into Mark Walter
TWG has denied the Cadillac F1 team is up for sale following an investigation into CEO Mark Walter in the US

Mark Walter might be unfamiliar in Formula 1, but for the Cadillac team, he holds fundamental relevance. The billionaire is the CEO of TWG, the company responsible for operating General Motors' Formula 1 entry, and currently he is under scrutiny by authorities in the United States which has sparked rumours regarding a potential sale of the team.

Recently, Walter sold his stake in the NBA's Los Angeles Lakers – just one year after acquiring it – while reports in the US have emerged that he is considering selling his shares in other sports ventures; including Premier League club Chelsea, MLB's Los Angeles Dodgers, and even Cadillac F1 and Andretti Global.
These moves are reportedly aimed at raising liquidity to deal with the ongoing investigation against him.
However, on Thursday at the Dutch Grand Prix, Cadillac sought to quell the speculation by stating the team was not up for sale.

Dan Towriss, Cadillac F1 team CEO, is not in attendance at Zandvoort this weekend – the first round with new team principal Marcin Budkowski at the helm - because he is with Andretti Autosport at the IndyCar race in Washington D.C., an event featuring the presence of U.S. President Donald Trump.
TWG acquired Andretti in 2024 after purchasing the stake from Michael Andretti, a key move that allowed the FIA, F1, and rival teams to approve Cadillac’s entry as the 11th team on the grid for 2026.

Currently, the U.S. Department of Justice and the Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating Mark Walter for an alleged fraud and cover-up scheme involving the management of funds at his insurance companies Delaware Life, Clear Spring, and EquiTrust.

The investigation is examining the legality of a network of undisclosed "self-loans" – estimated between $16-20billion – channelled from his insurance companies to businesses linked to the billionaire himself.
The money reportedly circulated through intermediary firms and an opaque structure of limited liability companies to evade regulatory controls and legal limits in the sector.

In the United States, companies owned by the same individual can legally lend money to one another, provided the transactions are declared to regulators to avoid compromising solvency toward customers.
keyPointsZh: 沃尔特近期出售了NBA洛杉矶湖人队的股份，距其收购仅一年。
有报道称他还在考虑出售其他体育资产，包括英超切尔西、MLB洛杉矶道奇队以及Andretti Global。
keyPointsEn: Walter recently sold his stake in the NBA's Los Angeles Lakers, just one year after acquiring it.
Reports suggest he is considering selling shares in other sports ventures, including Premier League club Chelsea, MLB's Los Angeles Dodgers, and Andretti Global.
